howto.text:
How to try it

• Press Play on the prototype, then click in the notes of “Review CS 489 lectures 10–14”.
• Type Markdown: **bold**, _italic_, `code`, [text](url), # and ## headings, - lists, 1. lists, - [ ] checklists, > quotes, ``` code blocks.
• ⌘B, ⌘I and ⌘K work on the selection or the word at the caret. Return continues a list; Return on an empty item ends it. Tab and ⇧Tab indent.
• Click a checklist box: it toggles the [ ] in the text, editing or not.
• Paste rich text from a web page: it arrives as Markdown. ⌥⇧⌘V pastes plain.
• The strip switches Notes, Checklists, Rows and Links. Press ? for every key.

n_edit.text:
Each board is editing the same note with the caret in “retr|ieval”.

A shows the marks of the word the caret touches and of the line it's on (# and >), and hides the rest.
B shows every mark, faintly, all the time: nothing ever moves.
C switches to the plain source while editing: lists lose their bullets and boxes, the text reflows.

At rest, A and C read the same: fully rendered.

n_chk.text:
A box toggles [ ] ↔ [x] in the text, editing or not, without moving the caret. Outside editing it's its own undo step (“Check Item”).

Square keeps the round blue box the task's alone: notes items are smaller, square, and fill gray when checked. Checked items read like completed tasks: dimmed and struck through.

n_rows.text:
Glyph: a quiet lines icon before the chips when a task has notes; when the notes have a checklist, its count (2/5) instead.
Excerpt: the first line, in tertiary ink, after the title, fading with it.
None: nothing.

All three keep the 30pt row.

n_links.text:
⌘K edits the link at the caret, or links the selection; with nothing selected it inserts the address. Return applies, Esc cancels, an empty field removes the link.

Pasting a URL over selected text links it. Pasting it alone inserts it, and bare https:// addresses show as links.
